title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
layout_note: Symmetric figure-eight: the model sits in the centre with the Input above it; Feedback on the left and Refine on the right are each joined to the model by a big arc out of the model's top side and a big arc back into its bottom side, giving two loops that share the centre.
grouping: No containers; the whole figure has a thin black frame. Each loop's step is explained by a one-line caption on a light-grey strip under it, starting with the circled step number. Each box has its own pastel fill: pink Feedback, peach Refine, lavender model, pale-blue Input.
shapes_depth: Square-cornered flat boxes with medium-weight black outlines and a soft drop shadow. Very thick black curved arrows with large heads carry the loop; circled numerals 0, 1, 2 sit on the arrows to order the steps. The model box holds a line-art icon of a brain made of circuit traces with a light bulb, above the label 'Model M' in a serif math font. Feedback and Refine labels are set in a large serif face.
proposed_highlight: The single model sits at the geometric centre and is the only box with an icon, making the point that both steps reuse the same model; bold words in the strip captions (feedback, refine) name the two roles.
lesson: For a self-feedback method, put one model box at the centre and draw each role (critique, revise) as its own loop of thick curved arrows out of and back into that same box, numbering the arrows to fix the order.
notes: elements 'other' = circled step numerals on the arrows. Venue NeurIPS from semantic-scholar; year 2023 is the arXiv year and the recorded venue year. The boxes, arrows and icon are recorded by refs crop as one embedded image (photo_share ~0.66), so the measured palette holds only the neutral text strips and frame, not the pastel box fills.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a symmetric figure-eight: one central Model M box with a Feedback loop arcing out to the left and a Refine loop arcing out to the right, both returning into the same model

relations.form: two closed loops of thick black curved arrows, each leaving the model from its top side and returning into its bottom side, around one centre box
a single Model M box sits at the centre and both loops pass through it, showing that one model plays every role
circled numerals 0 (Input into the model from above), 1 (feedback arc) and 2 (refine arc) on the arrows give the order

channels.colour: one pastel fill per role: pale blue = input, lavender = the model, pink = feedback, peach = refine; it identifies each box and carries nothing else
channels.shape: all steps are flat rectangles with drop shadows; the model box holds a brain-circuit icon
channels.line: one style: very thick black curved arrows for control flow
channels.frame: a thin black frame around the whole figure; grey strips beneath the side boxes hold one-line captions

quality.strengths: The method is the loop, and the figure is nothing but the loop: one model in the centre with two symmetric cycles makes 'the same model gives feedback and refines' visible at a glance; the numbered arrows fix the order without extra text.
quality.weaknesses: No nouns are drawn: no output, feedback text or refined output appears, so what passes round the loop must be read from the grey captions; 'Feedback' and 'Refine' are drawn as boxes beside the model although they are the model's own calls, so the boxes look like separate modules; the arcs are long sweeping curves rather than short paths; the stopping condition is not shown.

insights.structure: A symmetric figure-eight: a lavender Model M box in the centre with a pale-blue Input box above, a pink Feedback box on the left and a peach Refine box on the right, each tied to the model by an outgoing arc from its top and a returning arc into its bottom.
insights.data: There is no data drawn; the model box holds a line-art brain-circuit icon with a light bulb, and each step's meaning is a one-line caption on a light-grey strip beneath its side.
insights.emphasis: Very thick black curved arrows and oversized serif labels in the side boxes make the two-loop idea the whole figure; circled numerals 0, 1, 2 on the arrows give the order.
insights.flow: Input drops down into the model (0), arcs out left and back from Feedback (1), then out right and back from Refine (2), reading left to right across the bottom captions.
insights.avoid: With no example input or output the figure could describe any iterative method; pair the loop with a concrete text example as the paper's second figure does.

arrangement.units: four flat pastel boxes with drop shadows, no containers; whole figure inside a thin black frame
arrangement.shared: one central Model M box used by both loops
